blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Human-centric audio-visual editing requires precise alignment of lip movements, gestures, and expressions with speech. Existing methods process inputs through independent video and audio pipelines, preventing cross-modal interaction between visual editing and audio dubbing. Many of these pipelines further rely on mask-based inpainting. As a result, they suffer from poor lip-audio synchronization, cumulative pipeline errors, and an inherent mask-size dilemma. We present AVE, the first unified end-to-end framework that jointly performs reference-guided person swapping, insertion, and deletion across both audio and video modalities without requiring spatial masks. To overcome data scarcity, we design a synthesis pipeline and introduce AVE-Dataset, the first audio-visual editing dataset to provide 100K pairs with appearance and voice references. By combining Synthetic-to-Real reconstruction with preliminary audio warm-up, our framework transcends synthetic pipeline limits and mitigates audio-video token imbalance. AVE outperforms modality-separate audio-visual editing pipelines in editing realism, temporal consistency, and audio-visual alignment.
blocks.zh: 以人为中心的视听编辑需要精确地将唇动、手势和表达与语音一致。 现有方法通过独立的视频和音频管道处理输入,防止视觉编辑和音频配音之间的跨模式互动. 其中许多管道进一步依赖于基于面具的涂装. 因此,它们受到唇声-声学同步性差,累积的输油管错误,以及内在的面具大小困境的影响. 我们提出AVE,这是第一个统一的端对端框架,在无需空间口罩的情况下,在音频和视频模式上共同进行参照人互换、插入和删除。 为了克服数据稀缺,我们设计了一个合成管道,并引入了AVE-Dataset,这是第一个提供100K对外观和语音参考的视听编辑数据集. 通过将合成到真正的重建与初步的音频热暖相结合,我们的框架超越了合成管道的限制,缓解了音频-视频符号的不平衡。 AVE在编辑现实主义,时间一致性,视听对齐方面超越了模式-分离的视听编辑管道.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Content editing has long been an important topic in both visual and audio fields.
Representative visual editing tasks include object removal [ 57 , 58 , 13 , 34 ] , insertion [ 1 , 46 , 53 , 21 ] , and replacement [ 35 , 12 , 51 ] , while audio editing commonly involves voice conversion [ 22 , 29 ] , source separation [ 44 , 30 , 32 ] , and speech content editing [ 36 , 41 ] .
Despite progress in both modalities, independent audio-visual editing remains insufficient for human-centric scenarios where visual events and speech are intrinsically coupled across lip movements, facial expressions, and bodily actions [ 27 , 16 ] .
Human-centric editing such as insertion, removal, and replacement should be reflected coherently in both modalities, with consistent subject presence, identity, and timing [ 14 , 26 ] .
Thus, joint human-centric audio-visual editing has emerged as a key multimodal frontier and the primary focus of this work.
blocks.zh:
内容编辑长期以来一直是视觉和音频领域的一个重要话题.
代表性视觉编辑任务包括取出对象[57,58,13,34],插入[1,46,53,21],并替换[35,12,51],而音频编辑通常涉及语音转换[22,29],源分 [44,30,32],以及语音内容编辑[36,41].
尽管这两种方式都有所进展,但独立的视听编辑仍然不足以用于以人为中心的情景,即视觉事件和言论在唇动、面部表情和身体动作中具有内在结合[27、16]。
以人为中心的编辑,如插入、去除和替换,应在两种模式中一致反映,主题存在、身份和时间安排应一致[14、26]。
因此,以人为中心的联合视听编辑已成为关键的多式联运前沿,也是这项工作的主要重点。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Separate editing pipelines versus AVE
blocks.zh: 图2:单独编辑管道与AVE

blocks.en:
Existing approaches to audio-visual editing typically decouple video and audio processing into independent pipelines [ 19 , 49 ] .
Consequently, the visual editor remains speech-agnostic while the audio stage lacks visual guidance; this absent reciprocal conditioning degrades synchronization and compounds pipeline errors (Fig. 2 ).
Emerging joint audio-video generators prove that unified cross-modal modeling naturally leads to more synchronized and realistic outputs [ 31 , 15 ] .
Inspired by these advances, we develop an end-to-end framework that unifies the core suite of human-centric operations into a single model.
blocks.zh:
现有视听编辑办法一般将视听处理解为独立的管道[19,49].
因此,视觉编辑器仍然具有语音不可知性,而音频舞台则缺乏视觉指导;如果没有对等的调制,则会降解同步和复合管道出错(图2)。
新兴联合音频-视频发电机证明,统一的跨模式模型自然会导致更同步和更现实的输出[31,15].
受这些进步的启发,我们开发出一个端到端的框架,将以人为中心的核心业务组合统一为一个模式.

blocks.en:
However, training such a unified framework is severely constrained by data scarcity. End-to-end supervision requires paired audio-visual editing data, which is virtually non-existent in the wild and costly to collect manually at scale.
A common workaround is to reformulate editing as a self-supervised mask-and-reconstruct task [ 7 , 14 , 26 ] , where the target subject and speech are masked to reconstruct the original content from the remaining context.
Yet, such mask-dependent training imposes strict spatial constraints that often erase fine motion cues and surrounding context, causing visual artifacts and temporal instability.
To overcome this bottleneck, we build a three-stage data construction pipeline.
We leverage specialized visual and audio models to synthesize diverse editing pairs.
To improve reference adherence across diverse visual and acoustic contexts, we construct cross-pair multimodal references by retrieving the target identity across distinct scenes or synthesizing it with generative augmentations, providing reliable identity and timbre guidance while preventing copy-and-paste shortcuts.
Through multi-stage visual and acoustic filtering, we assemble AVE-Dataset, comprising 100K curated audio-visual pairs that support unified character Delete , Insert , and Swap .
blocks.zh:
然而,这种统一框架的培训受到数据稀缺的严重制约。 端到端监督需要配对的视听编辑数据,这种数据在野外几乎不存在,手工收集需要花费很大。
一个常见的变通方案是将编辑重新编订为自我监督的口罩和重构任务[7,14,26],其中目标主题和口语被蒙上后从所剩上下文重建出原始内容.
然而,这种依赖口罩的培训施加了严格的空间限制,往往会抹去细微的运动提示和周围环境,造成视觉文物和时间不稳定.
为了克服这个瓶颈,我们建造了三阶段的数据建设管道.
我们利用专门的视觉和音频模型来合成不同的编辑对.
为提高不同视觉和声学背景的参考一致性,我们通过在不同的场景中检索目标身份或用基因增强来合成目标身份,提供可靠的身份和尖锐的指导,同时防止复制和涂抹快捷键,构建跨pair多式参考。
通过多阶段的视觉和声学过滤,我们组装了AVE-Dataset,由100K个可支持统一字符删除、插入和交换的视听对组成。

blocks.en:
Based on AVE-Dataset, we propose AVE, an end-to-end framework for human-centric joint audio-visual editing, supporting three tasks within a unified architecture.
By taking complete source audio-video signals directly as input AVE preserves full spatiotemporal and acoustic context, producing harmoniously synchronized output under multimodal conditions.
AVE builds on a joint audio-video backbone [ 31 ] , utilizing its bidirectional cross-modal attention for synchronized editing across modalities.
To handle complex multimodal inputs, we introduce a Modality-Aware Sync-RoPE design that assigns role-specific positional coordinates to source, target, and reference tokens.
This preserves source-target temporal correspondence while aligning audio and video along a shared timeline.
Furthermore, we introduce a multi-stage training curriculum with bidirectional supervision: forward supervision (from a real source to a synthetic target) teaches the intended editing operations, while the backward direction exposes the model to real target distributions.
Together with audio warm-up, bidirectional joint adaptation, and quality-focused refinement, this curriculum mitigates synthesis artifacts and enables the mask-free editor to bootstrap beyond the quality ceiling of its synthetic training data.
blocks.zh:
基于AVE-Dataset,我们提出AVE,一个以人为中心的联合视听编辑的端到端框架,支持统一架构内的三项任务.
通过直接将完整的源音频-视频信号作为输入AVE保存了全相位和相声上下文,在多模式条件下产生和谐同步的输出.
AVE基于一个联合音频-视频主干线[31],利用其双向跨模式的注意力进行跨模式同步编辑.
为了处理复杂的多模式输入,我们引入了Modality-Aware Sync-RoPE设计,将特定角色的位置坐标指定给源,目标,以及参考符.
这保留了源目标时间通信,同时按照共同的时间表对音频和视频进行调整。
此外,我们引入了一个多阶段的培训课程,实行双向监督:前向监督(从真实来源到合成目标)教授预定的编辑操作,而后向则将模型暴露为真正的目标分布.
该课程与音频热身、双向联合调整和注重质量的改进相结合,减轻了合成工艺,使无口罩编辑能够超越其合成培训数据的质量上限。

blocks.en:
Our main contributions are as follows:
(1) We present AVE, a unified mask-free framework for human-centric audio-visual editing. It employs Modality-Aware Sync-RoPE to enable comprehensive cross-modal interaction while preserving audio-visual temporal correspondence.
(2) We develop a scalable data synthesis pipeline to construct AVE-Dataset, providing 100K verified audio-visual editing pairs equipped with appearance and voice references alongside a standardized benchmark.
(3) We introduce a multi-stage training curriculum with bidirectional supervision, enabling the final model to progressively surpass the quality ceiling imposed by synthetic training data.
blocks.zh:
我们的主要贡献如下:
(1)我们介绍AVE,一个统一的以人为中心的视听编辑无遮罩框架. 它使用Modality-Aware Sync-RoPE来进行全面的跨模式互动,同时保留视听时间通信.
(2) 我们开发可伸缩的数据合成管道来建造AVE-Dataset,提供100K的经核实的视听编辑配对,配有外观和语音参考,并配有标准化基准。
(3) 我们采用多阶段的培训课程,实行双向监督,使最终模式能够逐步超过合成培训数据规定的质量上限。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Joint audio–video foundation models learn visual and acoustic content as a coupled distribution rather than separate streams. Early works explored coupled U-Nets for unconditional synthesis [ 42 ] , while recent DiT-based models scale cross-modal generation to open domains with strong multimodal priors [ 31 , 15 , 3 ] . However, general generation capability alone does not naturally resolve the central editing problem: transferring requested attributes while preserving operation-irrelevant source content. Initial editing formulations adapted single-modality models to paired image–audio data [ 25 ] or relied on test-time optimization on video [ 28 ] . Modular pipelines follow a decomposition that separately inverts, edits, or dubs audio and video [ 12 , 49 , 19 , 55 ] , yet these one-way cascades lack bidirectional interaction and inevitably compound pipeline errors. Recent works move toward coupled end-to-end architectures [ 50 , 56 , 5 , 26 ] , yet they remain restricted to single operations [ 50 ] or rely on mask-guided routing [ 26 ] . In contrast, we combine external appearance and timbre references with mask-free localization to unify person-level Swap , Insert , and Delete within a single generative process.
blocks.zh: 联合音频-视频基础模型将视觉和声学内容学习为组合发行,而不是单独的流. 早期的工程探索结合U-Net进行无条件合成[42],而最近基于DiT的模型将跨模式生成的规模扩大到具有很强的多式联运前兆的开放域[31,15,3]. 然而,仅靠一般生成能力并不能自然地解决中央编辑问题:转移所请求的属性,同时保留与操作无关的源内容. 初始编辑配方调整了单模式模型来配对图像-音频数据[25]或依赖于视频的测试时间优化[28]. 模块管沿分解,分别倒置,编辑,或哑弹等音频和视频[12,49,19,55],然而这些单向级联缺乏双向相互作用,不可避免地使管道出错复合. 近期的作品走向了组合式的端到端架构[50,56,5,26],然而它们仍然限于单项操作[50]或依靠口罩制导的路由[26]. 对比之下,我们把外部外观和tumbre的引用和免面具本地化结合起来,在一个单一的基因过程内统一人级交换,插入,并删除.

blocks.en: In human-centric scenarios, existing studies have separately investigated visual identity transfer [ 35 , 51 ] and speech-driven facial animation [ 33 , 16 ] . While achieving promising portrait fidelity and lip synchronization, they primarily operate on the visual stream or require external driving audio, failing to jointly transfer appearance and voice. Conversely, joint dubbing and audio-video personalization methods couple appearance and voice for identity-consistent generation [ 2 , 24 , 6 , 9 , 4 , 23 ] , but they synthesize new scenes from scratch rather than preserving source-video context. DreamID-Omni [ 14 ] represents the closest effort by supporting reference-based generation and person replacement. Nonetheless, it does not unify person insertion and deletion under a consistent editing framework, nor does it preserve source motion and linguistic context as editing invariants. In contrast, our approach enables holistic identity and timbre control across all three operations.
blocks.zh: 在以人为中心的情景中,现有的研究分别调查了视觉身份转移[35,51]和由语音驱动的面部动画[33,16]. 虽然实现了有希望的肖像忠贞和唇相同步,但它们主要在视觉流上运作或需要外部驱动音频,未能联合传输外观和语音. 反之,联合配音和音频视频个性化方法使身份一致的生成[2,24,6,9,4,23]的外观和声调相配,但它们从零开始合成出新的场景,而不是保留源视频上下文. DreamID-Omni [14] 通过支持基于参考的生成和人员替换,代表了最密切的努力. 尽管如此,它并没有在一致的编辑框架下统一人物的插入和删除,也没有保留源动和语言背景作为编辑的变体. 与此相反,我们的方法能够使所有三项行动具有整体的特性,并进行严密的控制。

blocks.en: Audio editing provides essential capabilities for manipulating acoustic content in human-centric scenes. Zero-shot voice cloning synthesizes speech in an arbitrary timbre for character insertion [ 11 , 37 ] , while voice conversion preserves linguistic timing and prosody for character replacement [ 29 ] . In parallel, speech separation and extraction isolate target voices from acoustic mixtures to facilitate character deletion [ 43 , 49 ] . However, these audio-centric methods cannot exploit visual cues to resolve speaker attribution and lip synchronization in talking videos, nor can separation alone reconstruct vacated visual regions. Our framework integrates these editing capabilities into a unified multimodal backbone, allowing acoustic and visual decisions to co-evolve seamlessly.
blocks.zh: 音频编辑为操纵以人为中心的场景中的相声内容提供了必不可少的能力. 零射出的声音克隆在任意的tumbre中合成语音来进行角色插入[11,37],而语音转换则保留了语言时间和prosody来替换角色[29]. 同时,语音分离和提取将目标声音从相声混合物中分离出来,以方便字符删除[43,49]. 然而,这些以音频为中心的方法不能利用视觉提示来解决说话视频中的扬声器归属和口语同步问题,单独分离也不能重建已腾空的视觉区域. 我们的框架将这些编辑能力整合为一个统一的多模式主干线,使声学和视觉决定能够无缝地共同进行。

blocks.en: Building on this formulation, we present AVE. In this section, we first describe our data synthesis pipeline for obtaining complex editing pairs in Sec. 3.1 . Then we present our editing framework with Modality-Aware Sync-RoPE design in Sec. 3.2 . Finally, Sec. 3.3 introduces a progressive training curriculum with bidirectional supervision to overcome the quality ceiling of synthetic training data.

blocks.en: 3.1 Data
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Automated data construction pipeline of AVE-Dataset. The workflow consists of three phases: (1) raw corpus collection and quality pre-filtering, (2) video-audio synthesis for editing pair creation, (3) identity retrieval and multimodal augmentation for cross-pair reference construction.
blocks.zh: 图3:AVE-Dataset的自动数据构建管道。 工作流程由三个阶段组成:(1)活体采集和质量预过滤,(2)用于编辑配对创建的视频-音频合成,(3)身份检索和用于跨pair参考构建的多模式增强.

blocks.en: To obtain scalable supervision for joint audio-visual editing, we build an automatic data construction pipeline illustrated in Fig. 3 . In Phase 1, we filter 2.5M raw video clips to retain a 500K high-quality, dialogue-rich source corpus (see Appendix A.1 for details). In Phase 2, we synthesize paired examples for Swap , Insert , and Delete , and verify the resulting samples for visual, acoustic, and synchronization fidelity. In Phase 3, we construct cross-pair appearance and voice references through identity retrieval and augmentation, ensuring that the references preserve the desired identity and timbre while differing in pose, scene, and linguistic content. Additionally, structured editing instructions are annotated using Qwen3.5 [ 38 ] (detailed in Appendix A.2 ) to guide cross-modal editing intents. To guarantee dataset fidelity, a multi-stage verification suite (detailed in Appendix A.3 ) rigorously filters out visual artifacts, lip-speech misalignments, and identity-timbre mismatches throughout the pipeline. The resulting AVE-Dataset contains 100K curated audio-visual editing pairs, including 40K Swap pairs, over 35K Insert pairs, and over 20K Delete pairs.
blocks.zh: 为了获得对联合视听编辑的可扩展监督,我们建造了图3所示的自动数据构建管道。 在第一阶段,我们过滤了2.5M生视频片段,以保留一个500K高品质、对话丰富的源体(详见附录A.1)。 在第二阶段,我们合成了对等的例子,用于交换、插入和删除,并验证由此产生的样本,以便实现视觉、声学和同步的忠诚。 在第三阶段,我们通过身份检索和增强来构建跨侧外观和语音参考,确保参考物保留理想的特征和平缓,同时在姿势、场景和语言内容上有所不同。 此外,采用Qun3.5[38](详见附录A.2)对结构化编辑指令进行注释,以指导跨模式编辑意图。 为了保证数据集的忠实性,一个多阶段核查套件(详见附录A.3)严格过滤出整个管道的视觉文物、唇语错配和身份-不匹配。 由此产生的AVE-Dataset包含有100K编译的视听编辑对子,包括40K的交换对子,超过35K的插入对子,超过20K的删除对子.

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Edit Pair Synthesis
blocks.zh: 3.1.1 编辑对等合成

blocks.en: We construct high-quality editing pairs with aligned audio and video through a multi-stage synthesis and filtering pipeline (Fig. 3 , Stage 2). The pipeline has two branches: Swap , and the complementary Delete / Insert operations. The resulting editing pairs support both distillation from synthetic targets and reconstruction of real targets.
blocks.zh: 我们通过多阶段合成和过滤管道(图3,第2阶段),用对齐的音频和视频构建高质量的编辑对. 输油管有两个分支:交换(swap)和互补的"删除/插入"操作. 由此产生的编辑对既支持从合成目标中分馏,也支持重建真实目标.

blocks.en:
Person swapping replaces the appearance and voice timbre of a target person in the source video with those of a reference individual. It should faithfully preserves the original motion and poses, speech timing, and background audio.
For video synthesis (Stage 2.A), we employ Wan 2.2 Animate [ 7 ] with filtered source video clips serving as motion and pose drivers, combining them with reference facial images to synthesize videos with replaced appearances ( Person-Swapped Video ).
For audio synthesis (Stage 2.B), we first utilize BS-RoFormer [ 32 ] to precisely separate the source audio into clean speech and background noise/sound effect tracks. Subsequently, Seed-VC V2 [ 29 ] performs voice conversion using the isolated speech for content and prosody guidance with the reference timbre. The cloned speech is then remixed with background audio, yielding a target track synchronized with the edited video.
blocks.zh:
人物互换将源视频中目标人物的外表和语音发音取而代之的是参考个人. 它应忠实地保留原来的运动和姿势、发言时间和背景音频。
对于视频合成(Stage 2.A),我们使用Wan 2.2 Animate [7],过滤出源视频片段作为运动并摆出驱动器,将其与参考面相相结合,以被替换出相(Person-Swapped Video.
对于音频合成(Stage 2.B),我们首先利用BS-RoFormer[32]将源音频精确地分离为干净的语音和背景噪音/声效轨道. 随后,种子-VC V2 [29] 使用孤立的语音进行语音转换的内容和有参考timbre的prosody引导. 被克隆的语音再与背景音频重混,产生一个目标音轨与被编辑的视频同步.

blocks.en:
Removal and insertion are inverse audio-visual editing operations.
For video-level erasing, we track the target person in the source video using SAM 2 [ 40 ] to generate frame-wise binary masks, which are then fed into MiniMax-Remover [ 58 ] for inpainting to yield a background video with the target person removed ( Person-Removed Video ).
For audio-level separation, we similarly strip the target voice via BS-RoFormer, retaining only ambient background sounds and audio effects (or silence if no background audio exists).
From the resulting video and audio, we construct bidirectional editing pairs:
1) Removal : The original audio-visual clip serves as the source, while the person-removed video and background audio serve as the target;
2) Insertion : We reverse the pair and provide reference images and audio of the person to be inserted, using the original clip as the target. Thus, insertion is supervised by real, synchronized audio-visual targets.
blocks.zh:
移除和插入是反向视听编辑操作.
对于视频级去除,我们追踪源视频中的目标人使用SAM 2[40]生成帧相向二进制口罩,然后输入到MiniMax-Remover [58],以进行涂装来与被移除的目标人(Person-Removed Video .
对于音频级别分离,我们同样通过BS-RoFormer来剥去目标声音,只保留环境背景声音和音频效果(或者如果没有背景音频就沉默).
从产生的视频和音频,我们构建双向编辑对:
(1) 清除: 最初的视听片段是源头,而取自个人的视频和背景音频则是目标;
2)插入:我们倒置一对,并提供被插入人的参考图像和音频,以原始剪辑作为目标. 因此,插入由真正、同步的视听目标监督。

blocks.en: 3.1.2 Cross-Pair Reference Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1.2 跨公平参考建筑

blocks.en:
For reference-conditioned backward (using synthetic clips as inputs and real clips as targets) reconstruction, we need references for the original person. Simply cropping the real target would expose its pose, scene, or speech content, encouraging copy-and-paste shortcuts.
Therefore, we construct cross-pair visual and audio references that match the target’s identity and clothing but differ in background, pose, expression.
For visual references, we sample and crop one face per second from each video. We then compute face embeddings and use them to index the crops in an identity retrieval database. We retrieve candidate references of the same identity and further verify them through speaker-timbre similarity. After suppressing background sounds and sound effects, the corresponding speech segments serve as candidate audio references. Qwen3.5 rejects neighboring excerpts from the same continuous scene and candidates with inconsistent clothing, accessories, or hairstyles, which commonly arise when the same actor appears in different productions. We complement retrieved references with generative augmentation via Qwen-Image-Edit [ 48 ] and CosyVoice 3 [ 11 ] . For visual augmentation, an image editor swaps the subject’s background with samples from a background library while introducing subtle variations in expression and pose. For audio augmentation, CosyVoice 3 synthesizes new utterances from a text corpus using clean speech segments as voice prompts. All synthesized references undergo a final quality check (detailed in Appendix A.3 ).
blocks.zh:
对于有参考条件的后向(使用合成相片作为输入和真实相片作为目标)重建,我们需要原始人的参考. 简单裁剪真正的目标将暴露其姿势、场景或言论内容,鼓励复制和复制的捷径。
因此,我们构建了与目标身份和服装相匹配的跨平面视觉和音频参考,但背景、姿势和表达方式各不相同。
对于视觉参考,我们从每段视频中抽取并切换出每秒一面. 然后我们计算面部嵌入,然后用它们来将收成编入一个身份检索数据库。 我们检索同一身份的候选参考文献,并通过演讲者与发言者之间的相似性进一步核实。 在压制了背景声音和声音效果后,相应的语音部分作为候选音频参考. Quen3.5拒绝相邻的同名连续场景的节选和衣着,饰品,或发型不一的考生,常见于同名演员出现在不同出品时. 我们通过Quen-Image-Edit[48]和CosyVoice 3[11]对检索到的参考文献进行基因增强补充。 对于视觉增强,一个图像编辑器将主题的背景取而代之的是背景库的样本,同时在表达和姿势上引入了微妙的变化. 对于音频增强,CosyVoice 3合成了从文本库中取出的新语句,使用干净的语音段作为语音提示. 所有综合参考资料都经过最后的质量检查(详见附录A.3)。

blocks.en: 3.2 Framework of AVE
blocks.zh: 3.2 AVE框架

blocks.en: With the paired data in place, we build our editor on a joint audio–video generation backbone, so that editing inherits a strong prior on how speech, lip motion, and ambient sound co-occur instead of having to relearn cross-modal consistency from the editing pairs alone. Our design relies on only three properties shared across this family of models [ 31 , 15 , 3 ] : separate video and audio VAEs map the two streams into their own latent spaces; two Diffusion Transformer (DiT) branches are coupled by bidirectional cross-modal attention, so that each modality conditions on the other at every block; and a shared frozen text encoder supplies the semantic embedding of the editing instruction. Because we assume nothing beyond these properties, our method is not tied to a particular backbone. We instantiate it with Ovi [ 31 ] and adapt the conditional DiT blocks to source-conditioned editing.
blocks.zh: 配对数据到位后,我们将我们的编辑建在一个联合的音频-视频生成主干上,这样,编辑就继承了在语音、唇动和相通的环境声音上的一种强力,而不必仅仅从编辑配对中重新吸取跨模式的一致性。 我们的设计只依靠三个共有的特性 在这个系列的模型 [31,15,3]: 单独的视频和音频 VAEs 将这两条流映射到他们自己的潜伏空间; 两个分流变形器(DiT)分支辅以双向交叉模式的注意,这样在每个区块中,每个模式条件在另一个区块上; 共享被冻结的文本编码器提供编辑指令的语义嵌入. 因为我们假设除了这些属性之外没有其他东西,所以我们的方法与特定的骨干没有联系. 我们用 Ovi [31] 进行即时处理,并将有条件的 DiT 块修改为源条件编辑 。

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Source- and Reference-Conditioned Editing

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 4 , the source and reference inputs are encoded as clean context, whereas the target video and audio streams are initialized from noise. Within each modality, the target, source, and reference tokens are concatenated and jointly processed by the coupled DiT backbones. After joint denoising, the video and audio decoders produce the edited pair.

blocks.en: 3.3 Progressive Training
blocks.zh: 3.3 逐步培训

blocks.en: 3.3.1 Bidirectional Supervision
blocks.zh: 3.3.1 双向监督

blocks.en: Training only in the forward direction (from a real source to a synthetic target) would primarily distill the capabilities and artifacts of the data-synthesis pipeline. We therefore additionally reverse each editing-pair: the synthesized sample is used as the source and its real counterpart as the supervision target. This backward direction exposes the model to real target distributions and improves generation quality. We train primarily on backward pairs, supplemented by forward pairs. Forward supervision teaches the intended edits from real source videos without compromising the pretrained generation prior, whereas backward supervision improves output fidelity without encouraging the model to exploit residual synthesis artifacts as shortcuts. Our stringent filtering makes the synthetic targets used in forward training and the synthetic inputs used in backward training closely approximate real audio–video data.
blocks.zh: 只有在前进方向(从真正的来源到合成目标)进行培训,才能主要提炼出数据合成管道的能力和文物。 因此,我们进一步倒置每个编辑页:合成样品被用作源,而其真正的对应物则用作监督目标。 这种后向方向使模型暴露于真正的目标分布并改进了生成质量. 我们主要在后向对上进行训练,辅以前向对. 前置监制在不损害事先训练的生成之前的情况下,从真实来源的视频中教给预期的编辑,而后置监制则在不鼓励模型利用剩余合成文物作为捷径的情况下,提高输出的忠诚度. 我们严格的过滤方法使前沿培训中使用的合成目标以及后期培训中使用的合成投入与真实的音频-视频数据非常接近。

blocks.en: 3.3.2 Multi-Stage Training Curriculum
blocks.zh: 3.3.2 多阶段培训课程

blocks.en: Stage 0: Audio Warm-up. We first isolate the audio branch and train it on audio-only synthetic data for TTS, voice conversion, and speaker-timbre disentanglement. This warm-up is critical for mitigating the severe audio–video token imbalance and substantially accelerates subsequent joint optimization, allowing the audio editor to be efficiently integrated into the joint model.
blocks.zh: 0阶段:音频发热. 我们首先将音频分支隔离,并训练它用于TTS,语音转换,以及扬声器-发声器分解的仅音频合成数据. 这种热身对于缓解严重的音频-视频符号失衡至关重要,并大大地加速了随后的联合优化,使得音频编辑器能够被高效地融入到联合模型中.

blocks.en: Stage 1: Bidirectional Joint Adaptation. We train with both forward and backward directions. We first freeze the audio branch and optimize the video and cross-modal fusion modules on joint audio-video data, and subsequently unfreeze the audio branch to jointly optimize all trainable modules. This enables the model to acquire all three editing operations within a unified framework.
blocks.zh: 第一阶段:双向联合适应。 我们的训练有前向和后向两种方向。 我们首先冻结了音频分支,并在联合音频视频数据上优化了视频和跨模式集聚模块,随后解冻了音频分支,共同优化了所有可培训模块. 这使得模型能够在统一的框架内获得所有三种编辑操作.

blocks.en: Stage 2: Quality Refinement. We select the highest-quality subset from each data category based on VBench [ 18 ] , SyncNet [ 8 ] , and other quality scores, retaining only samples with retrieved cross-pair references for continued backward training. This quality-focused stage improves local details and reduces the residual artifacts from Stage 1.
blocks.zh: 第2阶段:质量改进。 我们根据V Bench [18],SyncNet [8] 和其他质量分数,从每个数据类别中选择最高质量的子集,只保留取回的跨页参考样本,用于继续后退训练. 这一注重质量的阶段改进了本地细节,并减少了从第一阶段开始的剩余文物.

blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
Implementation Details. We fine-tune Ovi [ 31 ] using LoRA [ 17 ] ; trainable modules are detailed in Appendix B . Training videos are standardized to a resolution of 480 × 832 480\times 832 at 24 fps with a duration of 5.04 seconds (121 frames), aligning with Ovi’s temporal grid. Audio is sampled at 16 kHz. For Modality-Aware Sync-RoPE, we set the shared RoPE margin to M = 350 M=350 for both the video and audio branches. Following the curriculum in Sec. 3.3 :
In Stage 0, we train the audio-only LoRA parameters with a batch size of 512 for 2k steps. In Stage 1, we train on audio-video pairs with a batch size of 64, running 2k steps with frozen audio LoRA parameters followed by 2k steps of joint optimization across all LoRA parameters.
In Stage 2, we continue backward training on the top-50% quality-refined subset with a batch size of 64 for 2k steps.

在第0阶段,我们训练只有音频的LORA参数,分批大小为512个2k步. 在第一阶段,我们用分批64分的音频视频对子进行训练,运行2k步并有冷冻的音频LORA参数,然后是2k步并跨所有LORA参数进行联合优化.

blocks.en: Benchmark Evaluation. Publicly available benchmarks closest to our setting remain fragmented. InstructAV2AV and JAVEdit provide multi-operation evaluation sets based on text instructions, without external appearance or voice references [ 56 , 5 ] . IDBench-Omni provides reference-conditioned evaluation, but its released source-video editing set comprises only 25 full-human-swap cases and 25 face-swap cases, with target dialogue specified by text prompts; person insertion and deletion into existing source videos are not evaluated [ 14 ] .
blocks.zh: 基准评价。 与我们设定最接近的公开基准仍然支离破碎。 instructAV2AV和JAVEdit提供基于文本指令的多操作评价集,没有外部外观或语音参考[56,5]. IDBench-Omni提供参考条件的评价,但其发布的源视频编辑集仅由25个全人游和25个面相游组成,目标对话由文本提示指定;个人插入和删除在现有源视频中不被评价[14].

blocks.en: To address these gaps, we construct AVE-Dataset-Bench, comprising held-out video clips strictly disjoint from our training set. Specifically, AVE-Dataset-Bench contains 64 carefully curated test samples for each of the three editing tasks, yielding 192 test cases in total. Models receive real-world audio-visual clips as source inputs, paired with reference images and audio as conditioning signals.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这些差距,我们建造了AVE-Dataset-Bench,其中包括与我们的培训内容完全脱节的被搁置的录像片段。 具体而言,AVE-Dataset-Bench包含64个仔细整理的测试样本,每个编辑任务,总共产生192个测试案例. 模型接收现实世界的视听片段作为源入,并配以参考图像和音频作为调节信号.

blocks.en:
Baselines. We compare AVE with two categories of baselines: separate audio-video editing pipelines and the text-driven joint audio-video editing model InstructAV2AV [ 56 ] .
For separate audio–video editing, each visual editor is paired with the corresponding task-specific audio editing pipeline. Specifically, we use VACE [ 20 ] as the general-purpose visual baseline across all three tasks: Swap , Delete , and Insert . In addition, for Swap , we evaluate Wan-Animate [ 7 ] and MoCha [ 51 ] ; for Delete , we evaluate MiniMax-Remover [ 58 ] and EffectErase [ 13 ] . To benchmark against end-to-end joint editing, we further compare with InstructAV2AV. Since InstructAV2AV is conditioned solely on text instructions and does not natively accept external visual or vocal references, we convert the reference subject’s salient appearance and vocal attributes into detailed text descriptions and append them to the instruction prompt.
blocks.zh:
基线。 我们比较AVE与两类基线:单独的音频-视频编辑管道和文本驱动的联合音频-视频编辑模型InstructAV2AV [56].
对于单独的音频-视频编辑,每个视觉编辑器与相应的任务特定音频编辑管道成对. 具体而言,我们使用VACE[20]作为所有三项任务的通用视觉基线:交换、删除和插入。 此外,对于交换,我们评价Wan-Animate [7]和Mocha [51];对于删除,我们评价MiniMax-Remover [58]和EffectErase [13]。 为了参照端到端联合编辑的基准,我们进一步与InstructAV2AV进行比较. 由于InstructAV2AV仅以文字指示为条件,且不本土接受外部视觉或相声参考,因此我们将参考对象的显著外观和相声属性转换为详细的文字说明并附加在指示提示上.

blocks.en: Table 1 summarizes the quantitative comparisons across the three editing tasks, and Figure 5 shows representative qualitative examples. Overall, AVE delivers competitive visual and acoustic quality, strong audio–visual synchronization, and high reference fidelity.
blocks.zh: 表1汇总了三个编辑任务的定量比较,图5显示了有代表性的定性实例。 总体而言,AVE提供竞争性的视觉和声学质量,强大的视听同步,以及高度的参考忠诚.

blocks.en: Swapping. In Figure 5 , AVE seamlessly replaces the target subject with the reference child. In contrast, VACE exhibits lip-speech misalignment, Wan-Animate alters the background layout, and MoCha degrades facial fidelity. InstructAV2AV modifies appearance via text prompts, but cannot recover the specific reference identity. Quantitatively, AVE achieves the highest identity fidelity (ArcFace 0.682 0.682 , CAM++ 0.647 0.647 ) and best audio–visual synchronization (Sync-C 5.39 5.39 , Sync-D 8.53 8.53 ).
blocks.zh: 捣为散. 在图5中,AVE无缝地将目标主体替换为参考子. 相形之下,VACE展出唇音错位,Wan-Animate会改变背景布局,而MoCha会降低面部的忠诚. 指令AV2AV通过文本提示来修改外观,但无法恢复特定的参考身份. 在数量上,AVE实现了最高身份忠诚度(ArcFace 0.682 0.682,CAM++ 0.647 0.647)和最佳视听同步(Sync-C 5.39 5.39,Sync-D 8.53 8.53).

blocks.en: Insertion. For person insertion, AVE generates a new speaker with precise lip synchronization on key syllables and clear facial details. VACE suffers from blurred eyes and poor lip sync, while InstructAV2AV produces an unnatural pose and disobey the prompt. In quantitative evaluation, AVE substantially improves audio–visual alignment (Sync-C 4.43 4.43 , Sync-D 8.83 8.83 versus 3.93 3.93 , 9.73 9.73 for VACE+PA) and achieves a higher imaging quality score ( 72.82 72.82 ).
blocks.zh: 插入 。 对于人物插入,AVE生成出一个新的扬声器,在关键音节上具有精确的唇同步和清晰的面部细节. VACE眼睛模糊,嘴唇同步不良,而InstructAV2AV则产生出一种不自然的姿势并违抗了提示. 在定量评价中,AVE大幅度地改进了视听对接(Sync-C 4.43 4.43,Sync-D 8.83 8.83相比于3.93 3.93,9.73 9.73相比于VACE+PA)并实现了较高的成像质量分数(72.82 72.82).

blocks.en: Removal. For subject removal, AVE naturally infills the vacated region without explicit masks. EffectErase generates discordant background textures, MiniMax-Remover leaves black artifacts, VACE fails to delete the target, and InstructAV2AV distorts the adjacent person while blurring the background. AVE achieves both the best background preservation (PSNR 31.74 31.74 , LPIPS 0.0926 0.0926 ) and the highest imaging quality ( 67.15 67.15 ).
blocks.zh: 清除。 为了清除标的,AVE自然地将空出地注入了没有明确口罩的区域. EffectErase生成不相通的背景纹理,MiniMax-Remover会留下黑色的文物,VACE无法删除目标,InstructAV2AV会扭曲相邻的人而模糊背景. AVE既实现了最佳背景保存(PSNR 31.74 31.74,LPIPS 0.0926 0.0926)也实现了最高成像质量(67.15 67.15.

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Study and Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 研究与分析

blocks.en: We conduct ablation studies on AVE-Dataset-Bench to validate our core training strategies, additional ablation of Modality-Aware Sync-RoPE is provided in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 我们进行关于ABE-Dataset-Bench的研究,以验证我们的核心培训战略,附录C中还提供了Modality-Aware Sync-RoPE的附加减缩。

blocks.en: Effect of Audio Warm-up (Stage 0). To verify the necessity of isolated audio warm-up, we compare our full model against a variant that skips Stage 0 and directly initiates joint training from Stage 1 through Stage 2 (with extra training in Stage 1 to ensure equal total training iterations). As demonstrated in our experiments, omitting Stage 0 causes severe cross-modal token imbalance and leads to degraded speech quality (AudioBox PQ) and poorer AV synchronization (Sync-C), confirming that preliminary audio warm-up provides crucial acoustic priors for joint optimization.
blocks.zh: 音频加热效应(Stage 0). 为了核实孤立音频热暖的必要性,我们将我们的完整模型与一个跳过第0阶段并直接从第1阶段到第2阶段(加上第1阶段的额外培训,以确保同等的总培训迭代)的变体进行比较. 正如我们的实验所证明的那样,省略第0阶段会导致严重的跨模式符号失衡并导致语音质量(AudioBox PQ)下降和AV同步性更差(Sync-C),证实初步音频热暖为联合优化提供了关键的声学前奏.

blocks.en: Effect of Multi-Stage Refinement (Stage 2). We evaluate the impact of Stage 2 quality refinement by comparing against a variant that continues training exclusively on Stage 1 data for an equal number of iterations without quality filtering. As shown in Table 2 , omitting Stage 2 leads to a performance degradation, particularly in visual quality and consistency metrics evaluated by VBench.
blocks.zh: 多阶精炼的效果(第2版). 我们评价第二阶段质量改进的影响,比照一种在不进行质量过滤的情况下继续专门进行第一阶段数据培训的变体。 如表2所示,略去第二阶段会导致性能退化,特别是在由V Bench评估的视觉质量和一致性度量标准方面。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We present AVE, an end-to-end framework for mask-free human-centric audio-visual editing that unifies person Swap , Insert , and Delete within a single generative process while preserving external appearance and voice reference control. To overcome data scarcity, we construct AVE-Dataset, a 100K-pair audio-visual editing dataset with multimodal references, and train the model primarily with backward reconstruction to leverage authentic targets as supervision. Experimental results across all three tasks demonstrate that AVE achieves stronger editing fidelity, temporal stability, and lip-speech synchronization than cascaded editing baselines.
blocks.zh: 我们提出AVE, 用于无口罩的以人为中心的视听编辑的端到端框架, 为了克服数据稀缺问题,我们建造了AVE-Dataset,这是一套100K平面视听编辑数据集,并附有多模式参考文献,主要以落后重建方式培训该模型,以利用真实目标作为监督。 在所有三项任务的实验结果表明,与级联编辑基线相比,AVE实现了更强的编辑忠心、时间稳定性和唇语同步。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work explores human-centric audio-visual editing for creative content generation and multimedia post-production. We recognize the potential risks of identity manipulation, deepfake generation, and unauthorized voice cloning. To mitigate these risks, all video and audio datasets used in this research were gathered exclusively from publicly available sources for academic research purposes. We strictly oppose malicious uses of identity manipulation and advocate the integration of synthetic media detection frameworks and digital watermarking alongside generative models.
blocks.zh: 本作探索以人为中心的视听编辑,以创作内容生成和多媒体后出品. 我们认识到操纵身份、制造深层假象和未经授权的语音克隆的潜在风险。 为了减轻这些风险,本研究中使用的所有视频和音频数据集都完全取自公开来源,用于学术研究。 我们强烈反对恶意使用操纵身份,主张将合成媒体检测框架和数字水印与基因模型相结合。

blocks.en: A.1 Source Corpus and Pre-Filtering
blocks.zh: A.1 源代码和预过滤

blocks.en: We collect videos featuring human subjects from films, television programs, and short-form video platforms. We filter the collection along multiple dimensions, including file specifications (duration, resolution, frame rate, and audio sampling rate), visual quality, temporal continuity and motion, visual contamination, suitability of the person and speaking scene, audio quality, audio-visual consistency, and content safety. We then stratify the retained clips and balance their distributions across key attributes.
blocks.zh: 我们从电影、电视节目和短片平台收集以人为主题的视频。 我们沿着多个维度过滤收集,包括文件规格(期限、分辨率、帧率和音频取样率)、视觉质量、时间连续性和运动、视觉污染、个人和发言场景的合适性、音频质量、视听一致性以及内容安全。 然后,我们分解保留片段,平衡其关键属性的分布。

blocks.en: A.2 Editing Instruction Generation
blocks.zh: A.2 编辑指令生成

blocks.en:
To enable precise model comprehension of cross-modal editing intents, we leverage Qwen3.5 [ 38 ] to jointly analyze source video frames, bounding boxes of edited/erased regions, and reference images, automatically generating structured instructions:
1) Unique Referring Description : Details the target person’s absolute and relative spatial position along with unique appearance traits, grounding the referring expression to prevent referent ambiguity during inference;
2) Action Prompts : concise editing directives (e.g., “ Replace the man in suit with the reference person ” or “ Remove the speaker ”).
These two components are combined into a complete instruction via templates and polished using Qwen3.5 to ensure strong generalization across diverse user inputs in real-world inference scenarios.
blocks.zh:
为了准确理解跨模式编辑意图,我们利用Quen3.5 [38] 来联合分析源视频帧、已编辑/已删除区域框和参考图像,自动生成结构化指令:
(1) 唯一参考说明:详细列出目标人的绝对和相对空间位置以及独特的外观特征,使参考表述打下基础,以防止推论期间的参考模糊;
2) 行动提示:简明的编辑指令(例如,“将西装男替换为参考人......”或“删除发言者......”)。
这两个组件通过模板合并成一个完整的指令,并用Quen3.5来抛出,以确保在现实世界推论情景中,各种用户投入的强烈概括。

blocks.en: For Insert , since the reference image and audio specify only the target person’s identity (appearance and timbre) but not their action or speech content in the video, we additionally annotate this information within the instruction: actions are annotated by Qwen3.5, while speech content is primarily derived from subtitle OCR and pre-obtained scripts, with ASR serving as an auxiliary check. These annotations preserve the temporal synchronization between action and speech, alternately describing the action and the corresponding utterance at each moment rather than listing all speech content at once. All instructions strictly omit explicit identity or timbre descriptions present in the reference inputs (e.g., specific facial features or vocal traits), preventing the model from exploiting textual shortcuts to bypass reference encoders.
blocks.zh: 关于插入,由于参考图像和音频只指定目标人的身份(出现和timbre),但没有在视频中指定他们的行动或发言内容,我们另外在指令中注明这一信息:动作由Quen3.5注释,而语音内容主要取自字幕OCR和预发脚本,ASR作为辅助检查. 这些说明保持了动作和语音之间的时间同步,在每一时刻交替描述动作和相应的语音,而不是同时列出所有语音内容. 所有指令都严格省略了参考输入中存在的明确身份或刻痕描述(如:特定面部特征或相声特征),使模型无法利用文字快捷键来绕过参考编码器.

blocks.en: A.3 Multi-Stage Quality Verification Suite
blocks.zh: A.3 多阶段质量核查套件

blocks.en: For generatively augmented cross-pair references, we apply additional modality-specific checks. Qwen3.5 verifies visual fidelity and the absence of visible artifacts, while ASR-based checks assess the linguistic correctness of synthesized speech. We then compute CLIP-based visual similarity [ 39 ] and CAM++-based timbre similarity [ 47 ] between each synthesized reference and the original identity, retaining only samples with a CLIP score above 0.75 and a CAM++ score above 0.70.
blocks.zh: 对于基因增殖的跨页参考文献,我们采用额外的模式特定检查. Quen3.5验证视觉的忠诚和缺乏可见的文物,而基于ASR的检查则评估合成语音的语言正确性. 然后,我们计算每个被合成的参考物和原始身份之间基于CLIP的视觉相似性[39]和基于CAM++的Timbre相似性[47],只保留CLIP得分高于0.75和CAM++得分高于0.70的样本.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 4 , replacing Modality-Aware Sync-RoPE with sequential RoPE consistently degrades imaging quality and AudioBox PQ across all three tasks. The full design improves imaging quality by 8.78, 4.68, and 3.27 points and AudioBox PQ by 0.659, 0.575, and 0.952 for Swap , Delete , and Insert , respectively. It also substantially improves audio-visual alignment for Swap and Insert , increasing Sync-C by 2.25 and 1.44 while reducing Sync-D by 1.31 and 1.18. Visual consistency generally improves as well, despite isolated exceptions in background consistency for Swap and motion smoothness for Insert . These results demonstrate that jointly preserving source–target temporal correspondence, separating token roles on the auxiliary axes, and isolating references with a fixed margin yields more reliable multimodal editing than sequential role encoding alone.
blocks.zh: 如表4所示,用相继的 RoPE 取代 Modality-Aware Sync-RoPE 将图像质量和音频Box PQ 持续地降低所有三项任务。 全程设计分别提高了8.78分,4.68分和3.27分和AudioBox PQ的成像质量,分别提高了0.659分,0.575分和0.952分,用于交换,删除,并插入. 它还大幅度改进了交换和插入的视听对接,将同步C增加2.25和1.44,同时将同步D减少1.31和1.18。 尽管互换的背景一致性和插入的运动平滑度有个别例外,但视觉一致性一般也有所改善。 这些结果表明,联合保存源-目标时间通信、分离辅助轴上的象征性作用和以固定边距隔离参考文献比仅按顺序编辑角色编码更可靠。
